purpose: Teach: プロット/譜面/増刊/アセスメント/書き下ろし/個人向け/抵当/約定

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪のプロットを早期に解明されますね
lines.en: So the police are quick to uncover criminal plots early on.
lines.style: Warm, acknowledging tone. Slight lift of admiration. Measured pace, leaning forward with genuine interest in the work being described.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯啓発ソングの譜面を作られたんですね
lines.en: And I hear the police even created scores for crime-prevention songs.
lines.style: Genuinely surprised but not skeptical. Gentle, almost wondering pace. The tone of someone delighted by an unexpected detail they didn't know to look for.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯誌の増刊号を発行されますね
lines.en: The police put out special issues of the community crime-prevention newsletter, don't they.
lines.style: Observant, nodding quality to the voice. Not questioning but confirming something he's noticed. Steady, conversational pace with a slight emphasis on the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、危機アセスメントを丁寧になさいますね
lines.en: And they're so careful and deliberate with their risk assessments.
lines.style: Steady appreciation. Soft emphasis on the care being taken. Unhurried pace, like he's weighing each word for accuracy. Quiet respect underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、書き下ろしの防犯エッセーをご寄稿されたんですね
lines.en: They even contributed an original essay on crime prevention, right.
lines.style: Light, almost conversational surprise. Raised slightly at the end like he's checking that he understood correctly. Warm but not overdone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、個人向け防犯指導も充実してますね
lines.en: And their crime-prevention guidance for individuals is really comprehensive.
lines.style: Affirming, with a small note of satisfaction. Gentle emphasis on how much they've developed this. Warm pace, genuinely pleased by the scope of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、抵当詐欺の事案を捜査されますね
lines.en: They're investigating mortgage fraud cases, aren't they.
lines.style: Straightforward, factual tone. A touch of seriousness now—the subject has shifted to actual cases. Measured, professional cadence without being cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正約定の事件もご捜査ですね
lines.en: And they're looking into cases of fraudulent contracts as well.
lines.style: Closer, more intimate register. The tone of someone moving into more sensitive territory. Quieter, slightly lower in register than before. Still cooperative but with more weight to it.
